description.value:
Harvested from something that treated other bodies as spare storage and meant it. On a critical hit with a natural weapon or unarmed Strike against a living creature, plant a Seed in them, no save. You always sense the rough direction and distance to any creature carrying your Seed. Once per day, 1 action: inflict 1d6 persistent bleed remotely on a seeded creature within a mile.

Rider: It was built to spread, not to stay put. Once per session in a chaotic fight, the GM may have a Seed root in whoever you crit next regardless of intent — friend, civilian, or foe.

cinderfall.incomplete: The whole ability (plant a trackable Seed on crit, sense its bearer, remotely inflict bleed on it) targets another creature's condition/HP from a self-held item with no selector for that anywhere in pf2e -- same architecture gap as the mutations pass's Grave-Quiet/Root-of-the-First-Fire, compounded by a remote-damage component that has no precedent at all.
